lines.en: I walk along with the patrol.

lines.zh: 防化服把我裹得严严实实。
lines.en: My hazmat suit wraps me tight.
My boots cross the foul water.
My mask rises and falls.
I walk on the outside of the line.
I scan both sides as I go.
My glove has something on it.
I shift the med kit to my other shoulder.
I step around a pool of runoff.
I keep low and hurry to catch up.
I follow the footsteps ahead.

lines.zh: 我踩着前一个人的脚印。
lines.en: I step in the prints of the man ahead.

lines.zh: 我每一步都踩在污水线外。
lines.en: I keep every step clear of the sewage line.
I stop to check the case.
I lift a foot and set it down.
I bring up the rear.
I lean on the wall and watch the corner.
I check the seams of my gloves.
My breath echoes in the mask.
I set the kit by my feet.
There is contamination in the air here.

lines.zh: 我把护目镜上的雾擦掉。
lines.en: I wipe the fog off my goggles.
I wait for the patrol to move.
I am counting the group in my head.
The wind rattles my outer suit.
I watch the door nobody shut.
I press the mask down.
Nothing living should be here.
I glance up at the sky.
I wait for the squad's hand signal.
I said nothing.
I count my breaths.
You do not look well.
You have a wound.
I look at you through the mask.
You came from the contaminated zone, did you not?
Stay where you are.
I lift the med kit.
I cannot hear you clearly.
Your fingers are quivering.
I half-crouch to size you up.
I have something to ask.
You do not look infected.
I will check you over first.
I brace on the wall so I don't drop to a knee.
There is a crack in my mask.
I press my side.
I angle away from the point.
My breath backs up in the filter.
I checked the wound.
I grind my teeth and bear it.
I can still hold out.
I hold the kit closer.
This is not the first time.
I do not touch this sort.
I have my rations.
Leave it by the door. I'll collect it.
I cannot eat this.
I can smell it even through the mask.
You eat first.
Save what is left.
My share is enough.
I do not want to take the mask off.
Keep that ration for yourself.
I cannot eat through this mask.
Take your mask off first.
This water is not drinkable.
I keep half for the wounded.
I push it back into the bag.
These are not my rations.
I brush your shoulder.
My mask tilted.
I straighten it quickly.
You went back two paces.
I put a hand out to steady you.
The kit rattled between us.
I edge past along the wall.
I did not mean to hurt you.
Get your footing first.
Do not crowd as you walk.
We are in the same patrol.
You check that side; I will take this.
Use the whistle if anything happens.
Do not take the mask off.
That wound needs wrapping.
We take turns on watch.
If someone goes missing, we search.
Keep up. Do not fall behind.
The kit is with me.
Follow behind me.
I pick it up with gloved fingers.
This needs sealing up.
Two presses on the seal, then it's stowed.
I avoid the liquid on it.
This is a sample.
I noted it down.

lines.zh: 我把编号写在样本袋上。
lines.en: I write a number on the sample bag.
I drop it into the sack.
This is no great find.
Sealed in the bag.
There is movement by you.
I raise a hand to signal.
I fall back to the patrol's flank.
That is no ordinary person.
I hold the kit down.
I tip my chin toward the mist.
The kit is ready.
I duck low and follow them in.
The signal comes from there. Move.
I steady the mask.
My eyes stay on that side.
I move up with the patrol.
Lighten your steps.
My breathing is loud in the mask.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，我数到第四次。
lines.en: Your breathing. I've counted four.
You are on the far side of the runoff.
I lift a finger.
Two blocks closer.

lines.zh: 我不先动，等你露出意图。
lines.en: I won't move first. Show me your intent.
The patrol has spread out.
I drive an elbow in.
The kit takes a hit.
I shove you with a shoulder.
I pin you against the wall.
I draw something from behind my belt.
The corner of my medkit hits his ribs.
I am pushed back.
Something splashed on my mask.
I wipe it off.
That block. You've been trained.

lines.zh: 我补上队尾空出的位置。
lines.en: I fill the gap at the end of the line.
My suit is covered in dust.
I checked the mask first.
This area has not been cleared.
The med kit hangs at my shoulder.
I come out of the white mist.
I signal the patrol.
Breathing echoes in the mask.
I take my place at the rear.
The ground is wet.
Fire melts my suit fast.
My knee gave on landing.
Water comes in through the mask seam.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的面罩打歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocked my mask askew.

lines.zh: 有东西打穿了我的外衣。
lines.en: Something punched through my suit.
This light tightens my skin.
My rations are nearly gone.
Lightning set the kit rattling.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以净化的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing here to decontaminate.
